title.narrative: Multisectoral Emergency Response Project Supporting Conflict Affected Returnees in Dambe Woreda, Kamashi Zone, Benishangul Gumuz Region.

description.narrative:
ltpgtASDEPO is proposing an integrated multi sectoral emergency response project targeting conflict affected IDPs recently returned communities in Dambe woreda in Kamashi Zone, Benishangul Gumuz region. The proposed project intends to scale up ASDEPO’s ongoing humanitarian response activities in the woreda which targets returnees and host communities. Through this project, ASDEO will support the returnees in Dambe woreda who are in need of immediate lifesaving humanitarian support. The project integrates Health, WaSH, nutrition and NFI Emergency response. The project is planned to be implemented in collaboration with Development Expertise Center (DEC) as sub-IPs who have sectorial expertise on WaSH. On the other hand, ASDEPO will also manage the implementation of Health, nutrition and NFI emergency shelter activities. Protection will also be mainstreamed across the thematic sectors to prevent and respond GBV, Priority for PwD and vulnerable groups. strengthen the sector specific needs. The proposed activities and the proportion of budget allocation for each sector is based on the woreda level needs informed by the multi sectoral assessment conducted for Kamashi Zone in general and Dambe Woreda in particular. The project integrates immediate lifesaving response activities and durable solutions that contribute for the recovery and resilience of the target populations. Key cross cutting areas are meaningfully mainstreamed across the project activities and reasonable resource is allocated for cross cutting activities. ltspangtThe project will be implemented in close collaboration and complementarity among the implementing partners and the government stakeholders. As part of the localization of aid efforts, ASDEPO is demonstrating strong capacities to enhance the organizational capacity of DEC. It will scale up its good practices and closely collaborate towards the attainment of the project objectives. ASDEPO and the Sub IP will ensure proper monitoring and evaluation activities to inform program management decisions with evidence from the field. Government counterparts will also conduct joint monitoring sessions periodically. ASDEPO and the implementing partners are active in the cluster system at national and sub national level. The coordination and reporting of project activities to the donor and the clusters via Activity Info will be strengthened. The project duration is 10 months’ period, and the total budget of the project is 1,000,000 USD. Through this budget the project will directly reach 37,142 persons in need in the woreda. Beneficiaries will get services in different sectors such as health, WASH, health, nutrition and Es/NFI.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
